metadata.timezone_basis: display convention; source dictionary did not independently confirm timezone
metadata.price_basis: unadjusted last valid snapshot and source reference previous close; not guaranteed official close
metadata.availability: Each date is released at the later of 16:00 Asia/Shanghai and the latest source snapshot for that date; daily retrospective only.
metadata.benchmark: Same-date sample median excluding the target security; not an official index or causal contribution.
metadata.screening: Keep finite returns and positive source prices; exclude known absolute reference gaps >1% and absolute returns >50%, with 1e-12 boundary tolerance. Unknown previous-observation reference checks are retained and flagged. Raw events remain visible.
metadata.prior_history: Use the five immediately preceding available stock-day observations, excluding current day. Require five valid values; missing history gives null, never zero or future filling.

flag_labels.reference_history_missing: 缺少前一观察日价格核验
flag_labels.volume_history_lt_5: 成交量历史不足 5 个有效观察日
flag_labels.spread_history_lt_5: 价差历史不足 5 个有效观察日
flag_labels.imbalance_history_lt_5: 盘口不平衡历史不足 5 个有效观察日
flag_labels.invalid_imbalance: 盘口不平衡缺失或超出有效范围

limitations: 仅覆盖 2026 年 7 月 23 个观察交易日，非完整多年历史或实时行情。
未复权价格及参考前收盘口径仍可能包含公司行动、上市或供应商定义差异。
同期差值、成交量和流动性变化是观测证据，不是原因、贡献概率或因果结论。
没有新增行业、新闻、公告或财报证据；不拟合长期 beta。
全日指标只在当日信息完整后展示；不用于声称当时盘中已知或可预测。
筛选后样本仍保留无法核验前一日价格的记录，并以提示标识；筛选不代表质量认证。
metadata.history_projection: Compact history is for charts; security code is the symbols dictionary key and availability comes from market_by_date. All event evidence and calculations retain full precision.
metadata.scope_authorization: User authorized using existing local real stock data for this new study; retained fictional demonstration remains separately labeled Demo.
